title: Travel Completed | APPR | VOL Only | Promise Updated | No Delay
description:
Customer made a VOLUNTARY change (unprompted by AC) to a later flight. No involuntary change exists on the booking. Under the promise calculation rules, when ONLY voluntary changes exist (no INVOL), the promise updates to the latest state INCLUDING the VOL � meaning the customer's chosen time becomes the new baseline. Customer arrived exactly on time per the VOL schedule. Delay = 0. Validates that: (1) VOL-only bookings use the VOL time as the promise (not the original booking), (2) A customer cannot claim compensation for arriving "later than original" when they voluntarily chose the later flight, (3) Zero delay from the updated promise = NE.

Prerequisites:
PNR: single passenger (Adult). Journey: 1 leg AC operated, Flight AC 428, YUL?YYZ. Original booking arrival: 10:00. VOL change: Customer changed to later flight � new arrival 15:00 (customer-initiated, no INVOL). INVOL changes: NONE. Promise rule: VOL only (no INVOL) ? promise = VOL selection = 15:00. Actual arrival: 15:00 (on time per VOL schedule). Delay from promise: 15:00 ? 15:00 = 0hrs. No arrival or delay code (flight operated normally per VOL schedule). Regime: APPR (domestic).
